description: Estimate the all-in cost for a jurisdiction. MUST be called before create_formation; returns an estimate_token required to create.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code to estimate for (e.g. WY, MI). Case-insensitive.

obtain_ein.description: Whether to include EIN (Employer Identification Number) obtainment in the estimate. Adds ~$99 USD and 2-4 extra business days. Defaults to true.

name: offshoreproz_estimate_cost

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry timestamp for the estimate_token (typically 15 minutes)
